name: haddowg/json-api-client
description: A typed PHP client for JSON:API 1.1 services, generated from your API's OpenAPI 3.1 document.

suggest.illuminate/support: Required by the Laravel bridge (Bridge\Laravel): the service provider, its published config and the json-api-client:generate command (^12.0 || ^13.0).
suggest.illuminate/http: Enables the Laravel bridge's native transport, which adapts Laravel's HTTP client to PSR-18 instead of pulling a second HTTP stack into your app (^12.0 || ^13.0).
suggest.illuminate/console: Enables the Laravel bridge's json-api-client:generate and :check commands (^12.0 || ^13.0).
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: Required by the Symfony bridge (Bridge\Symfony): the bundle class and its container extension (^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0).
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: Required by the Symfony bridge to register the generated client and its transport as autowirable services (^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0).
suggest.symfony/config: Required by the Symfony bridge for the bundle's configuration tree (base URL, auth, per-server clients) (^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0).
suggest.symfony/console: Enables the Symfony bridge's json-api-client:generate and :check commands (^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0).
suggest.symfony/http-client: Enables the Symfony bridge's native transport, which uses Symfony's own Psr18Client rather than a second HTTP stack (^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0).
suggest.opis/json-schema: Enables opt-in per-field validation of responses against the JSON Schemas the server publishes; without it the client applies structural guards only (^2.0).

scripts-descriptions.test-coverage: Run the test suite and emit a Clover coverage report
scripts-descriptions.cs-check: Check code style without modifying files
